profile.discardBody: Your photo, name, and bio will not be saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockScreenFooter: Lock-screen banners never include the note itself.
settings.newShyTextSub: Someone sent you a note at this venue
settings.checkInEndingSub: About 5 minutes before you go invisible
settings.deleteBody: This permanently removes your photo, name, bio, and profile. Any active check-in ends immediately. Chats you already started stay with the other person, but your profile will no longer appear.
settings.deleteBody2: You will need to sign in with your phone number again to create a new account.

privacy.p1: Your exact location is never shown to other users.
privacy.p2: Location is only used in the foreground to suggest a venue, and to check you out if you reopen the app more than 100 meters away.
privacy.p3: Being at a venue never makes you visible. You check in on purpose.
privacy.p4: Only people checked in at the same venue appear — and only after you check in too.
privacy.p5: We never show how many silent people are nearby.
privacy.p6: Chats stay private after you leave or your check-in expires. After an hour, the thread stays but new messages close so you can talk in person.
privacy.p7: Lock-screen notifications do not include private message text.

push.endingBody: Your check-in ends in about 5 minutes.
